## HTTP Lookup
Look up HTTP status codes and their docs via the `http` keyword.
- <kbd>⏎</kbd>: View the code details on `MDN Web Docs`. - <kbd>⌘</kbd><kbd>⏎</kbd>: View the code meme on `HTTP Cats`.
